findings_qualitative.value: NaCl, SiO, SiS and vibrationally excited H2O trace the individual disks at ~100 au, while CH3CN and SO2 trace the circumbinary structure at ~1000 au

evidence.quote: These are complementary to typical hot-core molecules tracing the circumbinary structures on a 1000 au scale.

findings_qualitative.value: Disk B appears to rotate opposite to disk A (tentative)

evidence.quote: We also tentatively find that the twin disks are counter-rotating

claims.hypothesis: Do NaCl, Si compounds and hot water trace the individual protostellar disks?
claims.experiment: Moment maps and PV diagrams of many lines at 0.05'' resolution
claims.result: These lines are concentrated near sources A and B, while CH3CN/SO2 are extended

evidence.quote: we found that the emissions of NaCl, SiO, and SiS are also concentrated in the vicinity of the protostars

claims.result: Velocity gradient of B opposite to A

evidence.quote: We want to emphasize that the detection of the counter-rotation is still tentative

claims.hypothesis: Are the sources at protostellar stage?
claims.experiment: Ionizing photon rates from 3 mm flux

evidence.quote: suggesting that the binary stars are at protostar phase with large radii of $\sim20\:R_\odot$

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Disk fragmentation origin disfavoured relative to turbulent fragmentation given counter-rotation

evidence.quote: A puzzling finding, however, is the tentative detection of the counter-rotating disks (Figure [4](#fig:disk)), which are difficult to form by disk fragmentation.

limitations_admitted.value: Counter-rotation tentative; contaminating unidentified lines; 3 mm flux is an upper limit for free-free

evidence.quote: We have not been able to identify these contamination lines.
